subject: Onboarding & billing path for pilot — PO requirement and temporary routing
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@greengrid.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Maeve Dalton <maeve@greengrid.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pilot onboarding — billing / PO question

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo this week — the GreenGrid team is excited to move the pilot forward. A quick procurement question as we start vendor setup: our standard process requires a PO for purchases, but for pilots we sometimes route invoices directly for faster start. Can Redwood accept invoices without a PO for a time-limited pilot (30 days) while we finish our internal PO setup?

Attached is our vendor intake form; happy to return any additional information. If we need a temporary alternative (e.g., pre-approved SOW or a short-term PO waiver), could you indicate what Redwood needs from our side to process invoices?

Proposed billing: 30-day net, one invoice at pilot completion.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Procurement | GreenGrid AI
procurement@greengrid.ai

Attachment: Greengrid_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@greengrid.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot onboarding — billing / PO question

Hi Olivia — great to hear you want to start the pilot. Short answer: we prefer POs for sustained billing, but we have an established path for short, time-boxed pilots.

High-level options we can offer:
- Pilot under SOW: sign a short SOW (we'll attach a template) and finance will accept invoice without a formal PO for up to 60 days;
- Temporary PO waiver: procurement can request a waiver if spend is expected to be under $5k/month — that requires a one-time approval from Finance (Marcus) and Procurement (Laura).

Next steps for GreenGrid to speed onboarding:
1) Return the vendor intake form (you already attached — thanks).
2) If you want the SOW route, complete the attached SOW draft and indicate the pilot dates/estimated spend.
3) If you prefer waiver, confirm estimated monthly spend and we will start an internal approval.

I've attached our PO policy summary and a blank SOW template. Marcus, Laura — tagging you for finance / procurement approval if GreenGrid opts for the waiver.

Best,
Irene Choi
Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Policy_Summary.pdf; SOW_Greengrid_Pilot_v1.docx

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@greengrid.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Maeve Dalton <maeve@greengrid.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot onboarding — billing / PO question

Thanks, Irene — that is helpful. We'd like to take the SOW route so we can start immediately and avoid internal PO delays.

Action items on our side:
- I'll complete the vendor intake and return by EOD Monday.
- We'll fill in the SOW draft you attached and propose pilot dates (2 weeks start, then scale if results look good).
- For billing, we confirm one invoice at pilot completion (Net 30). If Redwood needs a billing contact, please use procurement@greengrid.ai.

Can you confirm if Redwood requires any specific vendor insurance or W-9 prior to invoicing?

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Olivia

Olivia Chen
Head of Procurement | GreenGrid AI
procurement@greengrid.ai
Attachment: (resubmitting) Greengrid_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@greengrid.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot onboarding — billing / PO question

Hi Olivia — Laura from Procurement at Redwood here. Appreciate you choosing the SOW route; that's the cleanest for short pilots. A quick checklist from Finance/Procurement: 

1) Vendor intake form received and validated (Irene confirmed) — good.
2) Signed SOW is required before services begin. Please use the SOW_Greengrid_Pilot_v1.docx Irene attached and mark the pilot end date and estimated total.
3) For invoicing: we will accept one invoice at pilot completion on Net 30 terms once the SOW is signed. No PO is required for this SOW-based pilot.
4) Pre-invoice compliance: copy of W-9 (US vendors) or equivalent tax form + certificate of insurance (if services involve on-site access). If you cannot provide COI, note it in the SOW and we will evaluate on a case-by-case basis.

We can also set a temporary billing contact on our side if you need to push invoices while you establish your PO system — please send the billing email and preferred invoice format (PDF preferred).

If you prefer, I'll send a DocuSign envelope with the SOW and a short purchase memo to record the waiver internally. Olivia — want me to send that now?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
